    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "The rows are a tree: every span is a treeitem with its level, labelled with name, kind, status, duration and cost; aria-expanded on spans with children"
      - listitem: Roving focus – only one row is in the tab order, so the waterfall is a single stop
      - listitem: The details window is a dialog labelled with the span's name, with a close button; Esc closes it and returns focus to the row
      - listitem: The run's state in the bar (Live, Done, Failed) is announced politely when it changes
      - listitem: Ticks, grid lines and the "now" line are decoration and hidden from assistive tech
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: New spans slide in as rows and their bars grow from their start point
      - listitem: A running span grows live, with a sheen and a soft glow at its leading edge; a "now" line moves across
      - listitem: When the run outgrows the axis, the range glides to the next round value – ticks fade in and out where they are, bars rescale with it, nothing jumps
      - listitem: Folding closes the children's rows smoothly and shows their calls as small marks on the parent bar; the chevron turns
      - listitem: Rows that leave – a new run, removed data – close up a beat after each other, bottom first
      - listitem: The details window opens with a soft scale and fade from the row's bar, and closes the same way
      - listitem: Numbers that still climb – the duration, cost and tokens of a live run – carry a light shimmer
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything appears at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Built on a container query: wide, the span tree sits on the left and the timeline on the right"
      - listitem: Under 560px each row stacks – name, duration and cost on one line, the bar across the whole width under it; the numbers wrap to three columns
      - listitem: Under 360px the muted detail after each name drops out, so names keep their room
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass the whole tree every time something changes – ids keep rows in place, new ids slide in and grow
      - listitem: start and end are ms from the run's start, not timestamps – subtract the run's start time from your span times
      - listitem: cost and tokens are the span's own; agents and sub-agents add their children up
      - listitem: A retried call is a new span with its own id – keep the failed one, it tells the story
      - listitem: For a live run pass startedAt (the component ticks) or drive now yourself; once nothing runs, the axis settles on the last end
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-trwc, e.g. --ui-trwc-llm-bg / --ui-trwc-llm-edge for LLM calls
      - listitem: The chevron, warning and close icons are Hugeicons Free (MIT) – keep the credit comment when you copy the file
